set.body:
First-test-case evidence for the owner's MVP goal ("map the Sherlock recall transcripts back to the video"): the current Sherlock recall-to-video mapper, scored by the repaired fail-closed scorer, on development participants. Split out of bd-01M2TA6KFQV8ADNS3Z0ED4KYMW AC1 (the B3 reproduction read), which was transitively blocked on the local-LLM runtime (bd-01M2TA5VFE5X7E4SP1AM4HJ530 via pre-registration bd-01M2TA67DXJ2W0KX5N5DXSR1S2). The only prerequisite, the scorer bd-01M2TA5FB4ATF9QS9ZA9MDJNE2, is closed (docs/refactor/evidence/sherlock-scorer-20260919).

Scope: run the frozen mapping preset (docs/refactor/evidence/sherlock-baseline-20260919; embed-bench sherlockRecallMap / RecallToVideo.run, the only working recall->video mapper today) and score it with tools/recall-study/score.py under scoring-config.json. This is a development readout, not a held-out or superiority claim.

Acceptance:
1. A study-log ledger entry (docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md) is committed before the first gold read: arms, participants (development use only), primary estimand (participant average), preset/config/input digests, and what the readout will not establish.
2. Arm A (annotations only) is scored for every admitted development participant; per-participant and participant-average results, the exact command, input digests, producer SHA and scorer version are committed under docs/refactor/evidence/.
3. Arm AV (annotations + scene captions through the existing caption sidecar, STORYMODEL4S_SCENE_CAPTIONS) is scored under the same protocol only if a caption input with recorded provenance exists; otherwise the readout says "AV not run: no admitted caption input". Captions produced before the receipt-checked loader ("[media] Video-only source package: raw video to a checked timed source with media receipts") are labelled as such.
4. The readout states its relation to the historical ~63.8% record (docs/design/sherlock-fmri-analysis-readiness-2026-09-22.md): reproduces, differs (with the identified reason), or not comparable. No held-out, calibration or fine-time localization claim.
5. No sealed split (Friends, Memento) is read; their read ledgers stay at zero.

Follow-up (not acceptance): once the G2 facade bd-01M2TADC4VKSDZ2S9SXETH2MYM lands, re-run arm A through the public path and record byte parity or the difference.

Evidence: exact-SHA commands and digests in the evidence README; SD6 cold review of the readout text.
set.title: [G2] Sherlock development reproduction: re-score the current mapper with the repaired scorer
